DB.description: D1 database that stores the 5 minute readings and daily totals. Created automatically.

ALLOW_PUBLIC.description: Leave as `false`. The dashboard only serves visitors authenticated by **Cloudflare Access**; enable Access on the Worker after deploying. Set to `true` only if you want your energy data public.

SITE_TITLE.description: Name shown in the top bar, e.g. your house or plant name. Empty uses the plant name from Deye Cloud.

DEYE_BASE_URL.description: Deye Cloud OpenAPI host for your region. EU: https://eu1-developer.deyecloud.com

DEYE_POWER_UNIT.description: Unit of the power values the API returns, `W` or `kW`. Check /api/status after the first fetch: if PV reads 1000x too big or small, flip this.

STATION_NAME.description: Name of the plant in Deye Cloud, only needed if your account has more than one. Empty picks the first.

BACKFILL_FROM.description: First day to fetch history from, YYYY-MM-DD in your timezone. Empty means the last 30 days.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone of the plant, used for day boundaries and tariff zones, e.g. Europe/Warsaw.

OFFPEAK_HOURS.description: Cheap tariff hours as `start-end` ranges in local time, comma separated, e.g. `22-6,13-15`. Empty means a flat tariff.

GAUGE_PV_KW.description: Full-scale value of the PV gauge on the flow page, usually the array size in kWp.

GAUGE_GRID_KW.description: Full-scale value of the grid gauge, e.g. the inverter rating in kW.

GAUGE_BATTERY_KW.description: Full-scale value of the battery gauge, e.g. max charge/discharge power in kW.

GAUGE_LOAD_KW.description: Full-scale value of the house load gauge in kW.
